outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot aligns with and closes its gripper around the upper drawer handle (frames 50–70, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, visibly exposing its sides and interior (frames 90–113, image and left_ego_image). It releases the handle and withdraws (frames 118–150, wrist_image); the drawer remains open through frame 196 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended object displacement is established by the supplied views.
